People: Leonard Jenyns (author, Wikidata Q1819006), died 1893; Charles Darwin (editor, Wikidata Q1035), died 1882; Benjamin Waterhouse Hawkins (illustrator, Wikidata Q817732), died 1894. Waterhouse (Benjamin Waterhouse), 1807-1894 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The zoology of the voyage of H.M.S. Beagle, under the command of Captain Fitzroy, R.N., during the years 1832 to 1836. Pt. 1, Fossil Mammalia. Pt. 2, Mammalia. Pt. 3, Birds. Pt. 4 Fish. Pt. 5, Reptiles - vol. 3, London Smith Elder and Co., [1839]-1843, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/NHM_UK_L_3967753001.
